verified_facts.text: Hotel 41 evokes the feel of a private members' club.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's historic lounge and dining room is exclusively for in-house guests.

verified_facts.text: Hotel 41 is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms are individually styled in a black and white theme inspired by French cartoonist SEM.

verified_facts.text: All guest rooms have mahogany panelling and marble bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: Every room has a Savoir bed.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's monochrome design is complemented by mahogany-lined walls, open fireplaces and leather furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: A chic, monochrome design runs throughout the hotel, complemented by mahogany-lined walls, open fireplaces and smart leather furniture

verified_facts.text: The interiors feature prints by Rene Gruau, drawings by caricaturist Sem, antique globes and marble busts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lighthearted prints by René Gruau, drawings by French caricaturist Sem, and intriguing objets such as antique globes and marble busts

verified_facts.text: The Conservatory Suite has a glass ceiling, so guests sleep beneath the night sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: the exceptional Master Conservatory Suite with a glass ceiling to sleep under the stars

verified_facts.text: The Conservatory Suite is split-level.
verified_facts.excerpt: A split-level sanctuary beneath a conservatory ceiling, where daylight, stargazing and privacy meet.

verified_facts.text: The Conservatory Suite has panoramic views of the London skyline.

verified_facts.text: Rooms include evening turndown service.

verified_facts.text: In the lounge, sweet and savoury treats are laid out daily until late, alongside a help-yourself ice cream fridge, as part of the 'plunder the pantry' concept.

verified_facts.text: The Rubens offers two restaurants and a bar that Hotel 41 guests can reach without going outside.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rubens offers two gourmet restaurants and a happening bar without the need for Hotel 41 guests to venture outside.

verified_facts.text: Guests are welcomed in the Executive Lounge, where they can relax by the fire.

verified_facts.excerpt: Take a short walk from the hotel and you'll find Buckingham Palace, The Royal Mews and The Queen's Gallery.

verified_facts.text: The River Thames, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben and The London Eye are within walking distance.
